jobs.title: Volontariat (m/w/d/k) in der Presseabteilung der Internationalen Filmfestspiele Berlin
jobs.reason: This is a Volontariat — a trainee / apprenticeship-style training post explicitly for learning practical skills ("dient der Ausbildung und Erlernung praktischer Tätigkeiten"), which falls under the excluded apprenticeship/traineeship category. It is also a press/communications role in film culture, far outside the candidate's interest zones and comms experience.

jobs.title: Ton- / Medientechniker:in (m/w/d/k) für das Haus der Kulturen der Welt
jobs.reason: Requires a completed vocational training as an event-technology specialist (Fachkraft für Veranstaltungstechnik) in sound/video engineering plus industry experience — technical qualifications the candidate does not hold. It is an audio/media-technician role entirely outside the candidate's research and policy profile and interest zones.
